links.outcome: Predictive model performance change after retraining on post-implementation data, sequential deployment, and simultaneous models
links.effect: At fixed 90% sensitivity, mortality model lost 9% to 39% specificity after retraining once; lost 8% to 15% after AKI model implementation; simultaneous models reduced each other's effective accuracy by 1% to 28%.
links.quote: At fixed 90% sensitivity, in scenario 1 a mortality prediction model lost 9% to 39% specificity after retraining once and in scenario 2 a mortality prediction model lost 8% to 15% specificity when created after the implementation of an acute kidney injury (AKI) prediction model; in scenario 3, models for AKI and mortality prediction implemented simultaneously, each led to reduced effective accuracy of the other by 1% to 28%.

unlisted_practices: Record model use and clinician interventions in EHR data so that retraining can account for model-influenced outcomes
